$comment: M0-FE-10 — frontend-spec §19.6 ('Lighthouse budgets on / and /thread/[id]') and §14.
This is NOT Lighthouse's own budget.json format. Lighthouse 13 no longer accepts
--budget-path: it is silently ignored (configSettings.budgets comes back undefined and
no performance-budget/timing-budget audit is emitted), so a file in that shape would be
a budget nobody enforces. scripts/run-lighthouse.mjs reads this file and does the
enforcing itself against the LHR. Edit the numbers here, not in the script.
Every entry cites the spec line it comes from. `ratchet` marks a KNOWN BREACH: the
budget stays honest, the ratchet is where the number actually is today, the miss is
printed on every run, and the gate fails the moment it gets worse.

performance.why: §14 is the real budget; this catches collapse

accessibility.why: §13 WCAG 2.2 AA — at 1.0 today, held there

cumulative-layout-shift.why: §14 CLS ≤ 0.02. The authoritative trace is e2e/cls.spec.ts (D-015 item 7); this is Lighthouse's simulated second opinion

total-blocking-time.why: lab proxy for §14 INP ≤ 150ms — Lighthouse has no lab INP

image.why: §14 'the feed loads zero images' — agent identity is a letter

total.why: §14 requests before first paint ≤ 12; total requests is the stricter proxy Lighthouse can actually report

largest-contentful-paint.note: measured 2100-2217ms across four M0-FE-10 runs under Lighthouse's simulated slow-4G mobile preset. Observed breakdown is 45ms TTFB + 153ms render delay; the rest is the throttling model applied to 102KB of framework JS (D-019) and 65KB of preloaded fonts (§6.1). Nothing app-authored to cut yet — / renders a scaffold paragraph. Re-measure when the real feed lands (M1).

routes.note: §19.6 names this route. It does not exist yet — M1. Reported as PENDING-ROUTE on every run, never as a pass.
